create_MultiprocessContext: create a MultiprocessContext to launch worker processes as a callable entrypoint with stdout/stderr redirection
create_SubprocessContext: create a SubprocessContext to launch worker processes as a binary entrypoint with stdout/stderr redirection
run_PContext_wait: run PContext.wait to poll and wait for all launched processes to complete or fail with optional timeout
build_PContext_close: build PContext.close to gracefully terminate all worker processes and clean up redirect and error file resources
test_Std_from_str: test Std.from_str to parse a string into a Std flag value or a per-rank mapping dictionary
